Dear Markus,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Rovaniemi
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
P7W78T
Problem Description
: Missing converters in DC4,3 → fast shutdown is not performed correctly for group 3 and 4.
Troubleshooting
:
As we already aligned, this should be a KF214 related issue. Since the site is very far away, you will try to reach out to the customer and take a photo of KF214 and measure the output of KF214.
Apparently as I am writing this email, you already got the answer and we do have 12V constantly on KF214's outputs for the fastshutdown.
As such it's clear that the KF214 is not working properly and needs to be replaced.
Please order a new KF214 and proceed to replace it. If you need any assistance just let me know.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0387025
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

additional_info.subject: ID0387025-DC/Si-D/FI[P7W78T] - Missing Converters DC4,3 CRM:00315001976
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus,
After our site visit, we were able to bring the charger to operation.
One thing we noticed is that the KF214 was not responding properly to the door switch signal. I tried to apply a restart on the update of the PLC dispenser and it didn't work.
After you checked the connectors visually it seems like there were 2 loose connectors.
After you made this connections properly, the charger is operational.
As such I will close the ticket.
Best regards,
Francisco
